about: Width gate: box variants and which entries they draw. Read by tools/windows.py (marker.py, lint.py). px = line budget in px of the variant's font (big = enfont VWF, small = ensmall); "jp" = the JP's own cell width (16 px a JP char big, 8 small; pad strings: pad chars). lines 0 = the JP's own line count. last_px = budget of a page's last line (dialogue: wait orb); row_px = budget per row of the box (row 2+ uses the last). status measured = a stress line exactly px wide was seen whole in the named shot. Renderer map from tools/debug/drawcalls.lua (work/qa/dc/drawmap.tsv).

dialogue.last_note: the page-wait orb is drawn at x 226.. over the second row (work/qa/tort/orb.png): the last line of each page ends by x 224
dialogue.note: x 8..232, 224 px line whole with 3 px to the frame; VWF auto-wraps past 232; {0010} = new page

window.note: battle quotes and messages; newline = \n (0x81AD). Row 1 shows 224 px whole but row 2 drops a glyph ending past x 228 (work/qa/wg3/z.png); 220 px shows whole on both rows

battle_2row.row_note: row 2 continues in the tiles after row 1: 224 + 208 px (27 cells) shows clean, 224 + 224 overruns into the battle BG tiles (work/qa/wg6/tutorial_battle/scene.png)
battle_2row.note: tutorial prompts (and quote 135760); newline = \n, else split at 224 px; row 2 rest dropped

areas.note: map-menu area name: the drawer stops after 28 characters (224 px and 160 px stress lines both cut after char 28: work/qa/wg1/map-c.png, wg2/map-c.png)

obj_cells.note: each label owns one 16 px cell per JP char of OBJ tiles; the next label's tiles follow, so the JP cell width is the hard cap

names_list.note: skills, weapons, techniques: menu rows; measure in the shikigami/technique menus

speaker_tag.renderer: dialogue name plate: fixed 8 px cells, not VWF yet
speaker_tag.note: plate ~44 px; marker shows only 5 cells ('[4140'); needs VWF like the battle tag

small_label.note: battle BG labels, all 10 callers read: 40F718/24/30 at tile dests 0x0600CC80/CD00/CD80 (0x80 apart = 4 tiles = the JP's 32 px, 0x0810C1CE..); 410C0C (x 0) and 410C80 (x 27, 3 tiles to the screen edge) share dest 0x06009800. The JP's tile count is the hard cap

intro_strip.note: line drawn from x 8; a 240 px stress line is cut after x 232 (28 cells x 8 px)

credits.note: line drawn from x 0; a 240 px stress line shows whole to x 239 (30 cells x 8 px). Centre with leading spaces

name_grid.note: name-entry kana grid rows (glyph sets, skipped by marker.py); to be replaced by an English grid

fixed.note: debug menu, link-cable menus, battle help, one-kanji strings: JP width until seen in-game
